threads.body: `base64.b64decode(..., validate=True)` can raise `binascii.Error` (not just `ValueError`). Catching only `ValueError` means malformed/unsupported media payloads can raise out of instrumentation code.

threads.body:
`dict.get()` does not accept keyword arguments; calling `start_event.get(..., default=None)` will raise `TypeError` if `start_event` is a plain mapping. Use the positional default argument to keep this compatible with dict-like events.

This issue also appears on line 204 of the same file.

threads.body: The instrumentor appends the span handler directly to `dispatcher.span_handlers`, but the dispatcher exposes a public `add_span_handler(...)` API (already used in this package’s tests). Using the public method avoids bypassing any internal bookkeeping/deduplication the dispatcher might implement.

threads.body: Please import `get_dispatcher` from `llama_index.core.instrumentation` instead of `llama_index_instrumentation` directly (here and in the test suite). `llama_index_instrumentation` is an internal transitive dependency rather than the declared `llama-index-core` package, so importing it directly bypasses the public API and risks breaking if upstream restructures or vendors internal packages.
